title: Replace launcher-test fault injection by source substitution with runtime injection
outcome: Replace launcher-test fault injection by source substitution with runtime injection
acceptance: Launcher tests inject faults (diagnostic write refusals, native cleanup stalls, timing constants) through runtime seams or fixtures rather than by rewriting a copied launcher's or helper's source text, so a refactor that keeps behaviour does not break a fixture
The affected tests still assert the same observable behaviour (retained results, diagnostic output, receipts, warnings)
